culpritSource.quote: The two robbers were not responsible for killing Maki's husband. The real culprit is Maki Amamiya herself. Her husband only used his money towards buying and collecting toys rather than spending it on his own wife. As a result she concocted a murder plan, by pretending to be "God" on a online chat room she goaded the two robbers into robbing her own home to use them as scapegoats.

motive.zhHans: 她的丈夫只把钱花在购买和收集玩具上，而不是花在自己妻子身上。随后她等待着，并故意让自己被抓并被绑在壁橱里，这样一来，任何发现她的人都会相信她的丈夫是被窃贼谋杀的。
motive.en: Her husband only used his money towards buying and collecting toys rather than spending it on his own wife. She then waited and deliberately let herself be captured and restrained in a closet, so that anyone who found her would believe that her husband was murdered by the burglars.
